options.reason: The table is one row per HNSCC patient with a right-censored time-to-event outcome (Overall Survival (Months) plus Overall Survival Status, 191 events among 415 patients) and a panel of gene-expression features, so a Cox/proportional-hazards survival model of expression is the task the table was assembled for. PatientID is a row key only and must not enter the feature matrix; no duration- or status-derived columns exist to exclude. Derived risk groups are then validated once on external CPTAC with Kaplan-Meier and log-rank, as specified.
